### Challenge contract: bounded next contraction

```lean
PureSFormal.Challenge.ChallengePathUniversality.nextContractionBound (self : ChallengePathUniversality)
  (bits : List Bool) (index : Nat) :
  let system := EvaluatorBounds.finiteCTSSystem UniversalProgram bits;
  let before := system.contractionRun index;
  let stateCount := (PureS.FiniteController.runtimeStates UniversalController).length;
  let fuel := stateCount * before.cursor.erase.size;
  ∃ after,
    PureS.FiniteController.seekMutation UniversalController fuel before = some after ∧
      PureS.FiniteController.seekMutationDelay UniversalController fuel before ≤ fuel
```

### Exact concrete scheduler checkpoints

```lean
PureSFormal.PureS.SchedulerRecurrence.exactCheckpoint (program : CTS.Program) (dispatcher : ActionDispatcher program)
  (bits : List Bool) (horizon : Nat) :
  have system :=
    SchedulerInvariant.SampledGood.productiveSystem program dispatcher bits (SchedulerBound.bound program dispatcher)
      (SchedulerControl.initialConfiguration program dispatcher bits) ⋯;
  PublicDecoder.decode program dispatcher.tree
      (system.contractionRun (ExactCheckpointRun.checkpointTime program dispatcher bits horizon)).cursor.erase =
    some (horizon, CTS.iterate program horizon (CTS.initial program bits))
```

```lean
        ∀ (offset : Nat),
          PureS.FiniteController.run (PureS.SchedulerControl.machine program dispatcher) (preperiod + offset) initial =
            PureS.FiniteController.run (PureS.SchedulerControl.machine program dispatcher) (preperiod + period + offset)
              initial
```

```lean
PureSFormal.Research.ProtectedTrieLabelledObserver.labelledProjection_literal_final_on_cone
  (source : ProtectedTrieMachine.Instance) {term : PureS.Term} {entry : LabelledHistory}
  (hreach : PureS.Steps (ProtectedTrieStrong.strongEncoder source) term)
  (hmem : List.Mem entry (labelledProjection term)) :
  ∃ rows finalRow,
    ProtectedTrieTableau.decodeTableau? entry.payload = some rows ∧
      ProtectedTrieTableau.verifyRows source entry.history rows = true ∧
        ProtectedTrieTableauLabel.lastRow? rows = some finalRow ∧
          entry.label = ProtectedTrieTableauLabel.labelOfRow source.machine finalRow
```

Every emitted public label is copied from the final row of an accepted literal tableau in the current term.

### Ordered enabled slots and terminality

```lean
PureSFormal.Research.ProtectedTrieLabelledObserver.labelledProjection_slot_and_terminal_on_cone
  (source : ProtectedTrieMachine.Instance) {term : PureS.Term} {entry : LabelledHistory}
  (hreach : PureS.Steps (ProtectedTrieStrong.strongEncoder source) term)
  (hmem : List.Mem entry (labelledProjection term)) :
  entry.label.slot0Enabled = (ProtectedTrieMachine.step? source.machine entry.label.finalRow false).isSome ∧
    entry.label.slot1Enabled = (ProtectedTrieMachine.step? source.machine entry.label.finalRow true).isSome ∧
      (entry.label.terminal = true ↔ ProtectedTrieMachine.Terminal source.machine entry.label.finalRow)
```

The two enabled-slot flags and terminal flag agree exactly with the concrete ordered machine table.

### Confluence obstruction to exclusive branching

```lean
PureSFormal.Research.ProtectedTrieConfluenceObstruction.no_exclusive_fork_decoder {State : Type}
  (Next : State → State → Prop) (initial left right : State) (hleft : SourceSteps Next initial left)
  (hright : SourceSteps Next initial right)
  (hseparate : ¬∃ join, SourceSteps Next left join ∧ SourceSteps Next right join) :
  ¬∃ encoded decode,
      decode encoded = initial ∧
        (∀ {source target : PureS.Term},
            PureS.Steps encoded source → PureS.Steps source target → SourceSteps Next (decode source) (decode target)) ∧
          ∀ {state : State}, SourceSteps Next initial state → ∃ term, PureS.Steps encoded term ∧ decode term = state
```

A total functional decoder that is forward-sound on the encoded cone and complete for every source descendant cannot preserve two exclusive source states with no common descendant.

```lean

  (hright : SourceSteps Next initial right) (hleftSink : ∀ (next : State), ¬Next left next)
  (hrightSink : ∀ (next : State), ¬Next right next) (hne : left ≠ right) :
  ¬∃ encoded decode,
      decode encoded = initial ∧
        (∀ {source target : PureS.Term},
            PureS.Steps encoded source → PureS.Steps source target → SourceSteps Next (decode source) (decode target)) ∧
          ∀ {state : State}, SourceSteps Next initial state → ∃ term, PureS.Steps encoded term ∧ decode term = state
```

A total functional decoder with encoded-cone forward soundness and source-cone completeness cannot preserve two distinct reachable terminal source states.

### Protected directed subdivision

```lean
PureSFormal.Research.ProtectedTrieCertificateEnumeration.protectedDirectedSubdivision
  (source : ProtectedTrieMachine.Instance) :
  (∀ {left right : ProtectedTrieCertificates.BitWord},
      ProtectedTrieStrong.SourceValid (ProtectedTrieMachineCode.encodeInstance source) left →
        ProtectedTrieStrong.SourceValid (ProtectedTrieMachineCode.encodeInstance source) right →
          ProtectedTrieSubdivision.subdivisionCheckpoint ProtectedTrieStrong.sourceWitness
                (ProtectedTrieMachineCode.encodeInstance source) left =
              ProtectedTrieSubdivision.subdivisionCheckpoint ProtectedTrieStrong.sourceWitness
                (ProtectedTrieMachineCode.encodeInstance source) right →
            left = right) ∧
    (∀
        (left right :
          ProtectedTrieSubdivision.HistoryEdge
            (ProtectedTrieStrong.SourceValid (ProtectedTrieMachineCode.encodeInstance source))),
        left ≠ right →
          (ProtectedTrieSubdivision.subdivisionSimpleEdgePath ProtectedTrieStrong.sourceWitness
                  (ProtectedTrieMachineCode.encodeInstance source) left.source left.bit).walk.InternallyDisjoint
            (ProtectedTrieSubdivision.subdivisionSimpleEdgePath ProtectedTrieStrong.sourceWitness
                (ProtectedTrieMachineCode.encodeInstance source) right.source right.bit).walk) ∧
      ∀
        (edge :
          ProtectedTrieSubdivision.HistoryEdge
            (ProtectedTrieStrong.SourceValid (ProtectedTrieMachineCode.encodeInstance source)))
        (vertex : PureS.Term),
        (ProtectedTrieSubdivision.subdivisionSimpleEdgePath ProtectedTrieStrong.sourceWitness
                  (ProtectedTrieMachineCode.encodeInstance source) edge.source edge.bit).walk.Interior
            vertex →
          ∀ (history : ProtectedTrieCertificates.BitWord),
            ProtectedTrieStrong.SourceValid (ProtectedTrieMachineCode.encodeInstance source) history →
              vertex ≠
                ProtectedTrieSubdivision.subdivisionCheckpoint ProtectedTrieStrong.sourceWitness
                  (ProtectedTrieMachineCode.encodeInstance source) history
```

Exact history checkpoints and internally disjoint target paths form a directed subdivision of the ordered valid-history tree.

```lean
PureSFormal.Research.RootResetFiniteAllInputsTraceAgreement.selectsEveryContractionRun (program : CTS.Program)
  (layout : PureS.ActionDispatcher program) (bits : List Bool) (index : Nat) :

  RootResetFinitePrioritySelector.selectStep? program layout (system.contractionRun index).cursor.erase =
```

### Successful invocation operational agreement

```lean
PureSFormal.Research.RootResetContractProjection.some_result (contract : RootResetSelectorContract.Contract)
  (boundary : contract.InterInvocationState) (source target : PureS.Term)
  (selected : projectedStep? contract source = some target) :
  have final := contract.invokeRun boundary source;
  RootResetSelectorContract.runtimeHaltKind contract.haltKind final.control =
      some RootResetSelectorContract.HaltKind.redex ∧
    final.cursor.erase = target ∧
      PureS.FiniteController.runMutationCount contract.machine (contract.stoppingTime source)
            (contract.initial source) =
          1 ∧
        source.contractAt? (RootResetSelectorContract.cursorAddress final.cursor) = some target
```

A returned target is the actual invocation's erased final cursor, with a redex halt tag and exactly one successful contraction.

Public alias: `PureSFormal.Public.rootResetSomeResult`.

```lean
PureSFormal.Research.RootResetContractProjection.none_result (contract : RootResetSelectorContract.Contract)
  (boundary : contract.InterInvocationState) (source : PureS.Term) (selected : projectedStep? contract source = none) :
  have final := contract.invokeRun boundary source;
  RootResetSelectorContract.runtimeHaltKind contract.haltKind final.control =
      some RootResetSelectorContract.HaltKind.nf ∧
    RootResetSelectorContract.AddressNormal source ∧
      final.cursor.erase = source ∧
        PureS.FiniteController.runMutationCount contract.machine (contract.stoppingTime source)
            (contract.initial source) =
          0
```

### Fixed root, finite cover, and invocation bounds

```lean
PureSFormal.Research.RootResetContractProjection.invocation_bound (contract : RootResetSelectorContract.Contract)
  (source : PureS.Term) :
  contract.initial source = { control := some contract.start, cursor := PureS.Cursor.atRoot source } ∧
    (∀ (state : PureS.FiniteController.RuntimeControl contract.Control),
        state ∈ PureS.FiniteController.runtimeStates contract.machine) ∧
      RootResetSelectorContract.runSuccessfulEdgeMoveCount contract.machine (contract.stoppingTime source)
            (contract.initial source) ≤
          RootResetSelectorContract.runMoveCount contract.machine (contract.stoppingTime source)
            (contract.initial source) ∧
        RootResetSelectorContract.runMoveCount contract.machine (contract.stoppingTime source)
              (contract.initial source) ≤
            contract.stoppingTime source ∧
          contract.stoppingTime source ≤ contract.coefficient * (source.size + 1)
```

Each invocation has the same root start and finite runtime cover, with successful traversals bounded by moves, microticks, and the contract's linear tree-size bound.

### Ordered literal source sampling for every defined finite prefix

```lean
PureSFormal.Computation.SourceChronologyRootReset.exists_sourceClock
  (source : Research.ProtectedTrieDeterministicCompiler.DeterministicTape.Instance) (horizon : Nat)
  (endpoint : Research.ProtectedTrieDeterministicCompiler.DeterministicTape.Row)
  (endpointRun :
    Research.ProtectedTrieDeterministicCompiler.DeterministicTape.runFor? source.machine
        (Research.ProtectedTrieDeterministicCompiler.DeterministicTape.initialRow source) horizon =
      some endpoint) :
  ∃ clock,
    clock 0 = 0 ∧
      (∀ (first second : Nat), first < second → second ≤ horizon → clock first < clock second) ∧
        ∀ (fuel : Nat),
          fuel ≤ horizon →
            DeterministicTapePureSOutput.decodeRow? (DeterministicTapeRootResetOutput.termAt source (clock fuel)) =
              Research.ProtectedTrieDeterministicCompiler.DeterministicTape.runFor? source.machine
                (Research.ProtectedTrieDeterministicCompiler.DeterministicTape.initialRow source) fuel
```

Every defined source prefix has one strictly increasing clock starting at zero that exposes all its literal rows on the actual padded root-restarted path through the fixed bare-term reader. No executable global clock or ordering of every accepted observation is asserted.

```lean
  (a : Research.FiniteTreeAutomatonPowerset.Deterministic State) (source : Nat → Prop)
  (undecidable : ¬MaximalPaths.DecidableSet source) (encoder : Nat → PureS.Term)
  (encoderEffective : Computation.PartialRecursive.Computable fun x => (encoder x).code) (ending : Nat → Nat)
  (endingEffective : Computation.PartialRecursive.Computable ending)
  (sound : ∀ (t : PureS.Term), ending t.code ≠ 0 → ∃ path, MaximalPaths.Path.Accepts a path ↔ ending t.code = 2)
  (reaches : ∀ (x : Nat), ∃ t, PureS.Steps (encoder x) t ∧ ending t.code ≠ 0) : ¬MaximalPaths.Exact source encoder a
```

Closed certificate search converts the promised finite preprocessing and computable continuation analysis into a decision, contradicting source undecidability.

Public alias: `PureSFormal.Public.appendixFDecidablePathObstruction`.

### F.2.1: Finite unions and normal forms

```lean
PureSFormal.AppendixF.PathFamilies.finite_union_obstruction {State : Type} [DecidableEq State]
  (a : Research.FiniteTreeAutomatonPowerset.Deterministic State) (families : List (Analyzer a)) (source : Nat → Prop)
  (undecidable : ¬MaximalPaths.DecidableSet source) (encoder : Nat → PureS.Term)
  (effective : Computation.PartialRecursive.Computable fun x => (encoder x).code)
  (reaches :
    ∀ (x : Nat),
      ∃ t,
        PureS.Steps (encoder x) t ∧
          ((∃ family, family ∈ families ∧ family.answer t.code ≠ 0) ∨ MaximalPaths.NormalForm t)) :
  ¬MaximalPaths.Exact source encoder a
```

The obstruction includes arbitrary finite unions of analyzed continuation families and the normal-form alternative.

Public alias: `PureSFormal.Public.appendixFFiniteUnionObstruction`.

### F.3.2: Regular avoidance

```lean
PureSFormal.AppendixF.Carrier.regular_avoidance {State : Type} [DecidableEq State]
  (a : Research.FiniteTreeAutomatonPowerset.Deterministic State) :
  (∀ (t : PureS.Term), (avoidanceAutomaton a).accepts t = true → a.accepts t ≠ true) ∧
    (∀ (t : PureS.Term),
        (avoidanceAutomaton a).accepts t = true →
          ∃ next, PureS.Step t next ∧ (avoidanceAutomaton a).accepts next = true) ∧
      ∀ (left right : Code) (context : PureS.Context),
        (∀ (target : PureS.Term),
            PureS.Steps (context.plug (left.term.app right.term)) target → a.accepts target ≠ true) →
          (avoidanceAutomaton a).accepts (context.plug (left.term.app right.term)) = true
```

An explicit finite tree automaton gives disjointness from the target language, a native continuation, and coverage of globally avoiding carrier occurrences.

Public alias: `PureSFormal.Public.appendixFRegularAvoidance`.

### F.4.1: Unique-redex hold-only path

```lean
PureSFormal.AppendixF.RecursiveCall.hold_all_data {Label : Type} (table : Label → Admissible) (lengths : Label → Nat)
  (holds : ∀ (j : Label), table j = Admissible.holds (lengths j)) (label : Label) (data : Data Label)
  (outer : PureS.Context) (passive : HeadInvariant.Passive outer) :
  ∃ run,
    run 0 = outer.plug ((table label).term.app (Data.term table data)) ∧
      (∀ (k : Nat), PureS.Step (run k) (run (k + 1))) ∧
        (∀ (k : Nat), HeadInvariant.OneRedex (run k)) ∧
          ∀ (t : PureS.Term), PureS.Steps (run 0) t → HeadInvariant.OneRedex t ∧ HeadInvariant.NoPairs t
```

Every hold-only call, including leaf data and normal extra arguments, has an infinite path with exactly one redex and an all-reduct invariant.

Public alias: `PureSFormal.Public.appendixFHoldOnlyUnique`.

### F.4.2: Exact context and data update

```lean
PureSFormal.AppendixF.RecursiveCall.observation_next {State Label : Type} [DecidableEq State]
  (a : Research.FiniteTreeAutomatonPowerset.Deterministic State) (table : Label → Admissible)
  (c : Configuration Label) :
  observation a table (Configuration.next table c) =
    Observation.next a table (dataSummary a table c.data.rightmost) (observation a table c)
```

The finite summaries compute the exact next label, data summary and whole-term context.

### F.4.2: Exact intermediate observations

```lean
PureSFormal.AppendixF.RecursiveCall.observation_accepts {State Label : Type} [DecidableEq State]
  (a : Research.FiniteTreeAutomatonPowerset.Deterministic State) (table : Label → Admissible) (c : Configuration Label)
  (internal : c.data.internal = true) :

```

### F.1: Unique-redex clock

```lean

  (reachable : PureS.Steps ((PureS.C 0).app (PureS.C 0)) t) :
```
